$meta.name: Ludo NX screen registry
$meta.author: Claude (director)
$meta.rule: Pick the highest-priority screen that is not done and whose depends_on are all done. Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md first, then screens/<id>.json. Only the owner sets status to done.

specs.one_line: Applies to every screen. Read once per session.
Gameplay screen: wood wallpaper, house-colour turn tint, emoji/RULES+timer/message action bar.
How the pawns read as solid 3D pieces standing on a flat top-down board.

screens.title: Match HUD (gameplay)
screens.one_line: The board, four player cards, dice, ROLL, and the new action bar. The screen the game is played on.

screens.title: In-match emoji tray
screens.one_line: The 8-slot emote loadout, opened from the left button of the action bar.

screens.title: In-match quick messages
screens.one_line: Canned phrases, opened from the right button of the action bar. Not free-text chat - see the file.

screens.title: Rules / How to play
screens.one_line: What the RULES button opens: how Ludo NX is played, in three short tabs.

screens.title: Pause
screens.one_line: Resume, sound, rules, leave. The only way out of a match.

screens.title: Result (victory + defeat)
screens.one_line: The celebration. Two states off one builder: VICTORY! and NICE TRY!

screens.title: Home
screens.one_line: The front door: logo, mode carousel, NX MISSIONS and NX CUP badges.

screens.title: Pre-match cards (3 modes)
screens.one_line: QUICK MATCH, VS COMPUTER and PASS & PLAY on one hero-popup chassis.

screens.title: Shop
screens.one_line: Featured banner, four tabs, rarity-sorted product grid. Built to the approved v2 prototype.

screens.title: Shop item detail
screens.one_line: Big rotating render on a plinth, rarity, what it changes, BUY or EQUIP.

screens.title: Top bar + bottom nav
screens.one_line: The two pieces every hub shares. Fix these once and five screens improve.

screens.title: Profile
screens.one_line: Tall popup: avatar on the top edge, player ID with copy, STATS and BADGES tabs.

screens.title: Match found
screens.one_line: Diagonal house-colour split, both avatars, VS, countdown from 3.

screens.title: Match entry (doors)
screens.one_line: Doors close, board loads, doors open. Used here and nowhere else.

screens.title: Splash / first load
screens.one_line: Logo, mascot, a progress bar that tells the truth.

screens.title: Rankings
screens.one_line: Podium, rank rows, pinned self row, reward bands. Waits for real players.

screens.title: Friends
screens.one_line: LIST and REQUESTS tabs, search, friend rows with an online dot.

screens.title: Settings
screens.one_line: Grouped toggles in a well, option buttons for the sub-pages, player ID, version.

screens.title: Language, Legal, Notifications
screens.one_line: Three small popups that hang off Settings and share one builder.

screens.title: Missions / Daily missions
screens.one_line: Mission rows with progress and CLAIM, a bonus chest well, CLAIM ALL on the bottom edge.

screens.title: Wallet + Energy
screens.one_line: What the + on each top-bar pill opens. Two popups, one builder.

screens.title: Side drawer (menu)
screens.one_line: What the top-bar burger opens: mascot hero and every destination as a row.

screens.title: Edit profile
screens.one_line: Change name and avatar. Validation and error states.

screens.title: Avatar picker
screens.one_line: Arch-top NX Card, grid of avatars, locked ones showing how to unlock.

screens.title: Confirm dialog
screens.one_line: One question, two buttons. Used by leave match, remove friend, delete account.

screens.title: Mini profile
screens.one_line: Tap anyone anywhere: avatar, level, win rate, ADD FRIEND.

screens.title: Player stats
screens.one_line: The full career numbers, behind the profile's STATS tab.

screens.title: Offer / paywall
screens.one_line: STARTER PACK and NX CLUB. Must show price, period, renewal terms and the legal links.

screens.title: Daily reward
screens.one_line: Seven day cards, today lit and bouncing, day seven a chest.

screens.title: Level up
screens.one_line: Rays, the new level as a hero number, what it unlocked, CONTINUE.

screens.title: Pack / chest opening
screens.one_line: The chest opens, items fly out in rarity order, the rarest last.

screens.title: Album / collection
screens.one_line: Everything you own and everything you do not, as a grid with completion.

screens.title: Levels track
screens.one_line: The level ladder and what each level unlocks. Decision D5.

screens.title: Events + event detail
screens.one_line: Limited-time events list and one event's rules and rewards.

screens.title: Inbox
screens.one_line: Messages and gifts from the team, with a CLAIM on attachments.

screens.title: Connection and error states
screens.one_line: Reconnecting, opponent left, no network, maintenance. The screens nobody designs and every player sees.
